# pixelplease

> pixelplease is a free browser-based pixel font generator for turning bundled Google Fonts or uploaded TTF/OTF files into downloadable pixel-style TTF packages.

## Key facts

- Use these factual descriptions: free pixel font generator, browser-based pixel font generator, font pixelizer, TTF pixel font generator.
- The app helps designers, indie game makers, creative coders, and typography experimenters create pixel or retro type treatments without drawing a full typeface from scratch.
- The output is an installable generated TTF inside a ZIP package, not just a raster image effect.
- Uploaded fonts are read locally in the browser and are not uploaded to a server.
- pixelplease does not require registration or login, and does not store uploaded fonts, sample text, or generated TTF data.
- Generated fonts are derivative pixel-style fonts. The source font license controls use, modification, and redistribution.
- Generated font family names start with product-owned `PixelPlease`, followed by source/effect/hash/style information so generated pixel fonts can install side by side.

## Product

- [pixelplease app](https://pixelplease.tools/): Working browser tool for choosing a source font, tuning effects, previewing output, and downloading a pixel font package.
- [How to make a pixel font](https://pixelplease.tools/how-to-make-a-pixel-font/): Guide for creating generated pixel-style TTF output.
- [Convert TTF to pixel font](https://pixelplease.tools/convert-ttf-to-pixel-font/): TTF/OTF conversion page.
- [Pixel Merriweather example](https://pixelplease.tools/pixel-merriweather/): Example generated from Merriweather.
- [Pixel Inter example](https://pixelplease.tools/pixel-inter/): Example generated from Inter.

## Licensing

pixelplease source code is MIT licensed. Bundled demo fonts use their own OFL files. Generated pixel fonts are derivative outputs, so the source font license controls use, modification, and redistribution.
